newsitem.title: ITALY: Montedison sells Montecatini to Sued-Chemie.
newsitem.headline: Montedison sells Montecatini to Sued-Chemie.

text.p: Italian agrichemical group Montedison said its 100 percent-owned Montecatini SpA subsidiary had sold its Montecatini Tecnologie Srl unit to Germany's Sued-Chemie group for 62.82 billion lire cash.

Montedison said in a statement that Montecatini Tecnologie, which makes catalysts for the petrochemical and pharmaceutical industry at its Novara plant, will continue to operate under the name of Sued-Chemie MT Srl.

Two other contracts were also signed bringing in 15 billion lire, Montedison said, one concerning a commitment not to compete with the Montedison group, and a second concerning the use of the name and brand of Montecatini.
